title: Finetuned Language Models Are Zero-Shot Learners
authors: J. Wei, M. Bosma, V. Zhao, K. Guu, A. Yu, B. Lester, N. Du, A. Dai, et al. (9 authors)
before: Few-shot prompting worked, but models did not reliably follow a plain instruction.
problem: A pretrained model completes text; it has no particular reason to do what you ask.
breakthrough: Fine-tune on many tasks phrased as natural-language instructions, then test on held-out task types.
why: Instruction following turned out to be a learnable skill that generalises. This is the step before RLHF.
next: T0 in parallel, Flan-T5 at scale, and InstructGPT's supervised stage.
inherits: Instruction tuning as the first stage of every assistant's post-training.
